file_stem: RWB E1 022 Sign on with SSO MFA and the first roles
title: Sign-on with SSO, MFA and the first roles
goal: Entra ID sign-on with MFA is the only way in; roles come from group membership and menus follow permissions
why: No local passwords. A person holds a role only through an Entra group, a second factor is required, and conflicting role pairs are refused.
triggers: Entra ID OIDC token: groups + amr claims
ace_note: No recovery.v_ace_* read. v_ace_iam_group (Section B) exists but is not used here; ACE's common module performs the sign-in.

writes.note: role pairs that may not be held together

reads.note: letters per capability area, matrix version

stores: Entra ID (INT-21): groups and amr claims; ACE audit and SOC log (INT-22) for sign-in and refusal events
rules: BR1: Entra group membership is the only way to hold a role; no local passwords
BR2: a second factor is required
BR5: conflicting role pairs are refused
BR7: a session keeps the matrix version it resolved at sign-in
example: User U-1001 is in group RWB-SIT-RW-CASEOWN
-> role RW-CASEOWN, scope OWN, matrix PM-2026.11
Banner: 'Case owner. Scope: own cases.'  No Administration menu
